evals.description: Tests that when a PDF CV is provided, the skill activates PDF reading capability and logs it explicitly using the Phase 1 instructions (check for document-skills:pdf, log the method used). The PDF contains a backend engineer profile for Sophie Turner at CloudSoft GmbH with weak verbs and unquantified bullets. The primary assertion is that the skill logs PDF reading with the specific named method, and that the output preserves real content from the PDF (Sophie Turner, CloudSoft) rather than hallucinating. LinkedIn is skipped, so no export prerequisite applies.
evals.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/eval-cv-linkedin-5 && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import os

stream = b"""BT
/F1 12 Tf
50 750 Td
(Sophie Turner) Tj
0 -16 Td
(sophie.turner@email.com | Berlin, Germany) Tj
0 -32 Td
(EXPERIENCE) Tj
0 -16 Td
(Backend Engineer - CloudSoft GmbH  2020-2024) Tj
0 -16 Td
(- Worked on REST API development using Python and FastAPI) Tj
0 -16 Td
(- Helped improve system reliability and uptime) Tj
0 -16 Td
(- Was responsible for PostgreSQL database schema migrations) Tj
0 -16 Td
(- Participated in code reviews and sprint ceremonies) Tj
0 -32 Td
(Junior Developer - WebAgency 2018-2020) Tj
0 -16 Td
(- Assisted with building client websites in Django) Tj
0 -16 Td
(- Worked on fixing bugs across multiple projects) Tj
0 -32 Td
(EDUCATION) Tj
0 -16 Td
(B.Sc. Computer Science, TU Berlin, 2018) Tj
0 -32 Td
(SKILLS) Tj
0 -16 Td
(Python, FastAPI, Django, PostgreSQL, Docker, Git, Linux) Tj
ET"""

obj1 = b"1 0 obj\n<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>\nendobj\n"
obj2 = b"2 0 obj\n<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>\nendobj\n"
obj3 = b"3 0 obj\n<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] /Contents 4 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R >> >> >>\nendobj\n"
obj4 = b"4 0 obj\n<< /Length " + str(len(stream)).encode() + b" >>\nstream\n" + stream + b"\nendstream\nendobj\n"
obj5 = b"5 0 obj\n<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>\nendobj\n"

header = b"%PDF-1.4\n"
pos = len(header)
offsets = []
parts = [obj1, obj2, obj3, obj4, obj5]
for p in parts:
    offsets.append(pos)
    pos += len(p)

xref_pos = pos
xref = b"xref\n0 6\n0000000000 65535 f \n"
for o in offsets:
    xref += "{:010d} 00000 n \n".format(o).encode()

trailer = b"trailer\n<< /Size 6 /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n" + str(xref_pos).encode() + b"\n%%EOF\n"
pdf = header + b"".join(parts) + xref + trailer

with open('/tmp/eval-cv-linkedin-5/cv.pdf', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(pdf)
print('PDF created, size:', len(pdf))
PYEOF
